notes.title: Redo: Refactor Live Stream Q&A with Developers!

notes.title: Refactor Beta!
notes.content:
Refactor Beta!

It’s the beginning of a new year and a new decade and we are excited to announce that Refactor is finally ready to move into the next stage of development: beta testing! We’re going to perform multiple beta invites in phases and we need your help. 

For those who want to skip the development update and go straight to the invite link, here: [url=https://forms.gle/FHd71dMcnn8HjdzT6]https://forms.gle/FHd71dMcnn8HjdzT6[/url]

And you can join our official Discord Server here: [url=https://discord.gg/eVVecRg]https://discord.gg/eVVecRg[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4VZAoTG.png[/img]

We’ve been busy these last few years refining a raw torrent of ideas into what is now the final vision of Refactor. Systems have been streamlined, interfaces unified, gameplay progression mapped, cutscenes storyboarded and graphics upgraded. It took longer than expected but Refactor is really becoming a game of its own, and it’s a unique one!

When we first started Refactor, we were using version 4 of Unity. Unity has produced 4 new versions since then and we’ve been keeping pace. Taking advantage of the new features, we were able to increase visual fidelity and add improved visual effects without taking too much of a hit to performance. Not only does it look better, it also runs better. Cross platform support has been great, so we’re on track to launch on the PC (+linux/mac), PS4, Xbox One and, recently announced, the Nintendo Switch.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qBPDzdr.png[/img]

We’ve been hard at work on the content of Refactor. Roughly 50% of the content of the game is beta ready and we’re looking for volunteers to help playtest and QA the first half of the game. We intend to do three different phases of testing: the first phase at 50% of content, the second with 75%, and the final with 100% of the game completed. If you would like to play a fuller version of the game but would still like to participate in the beta, you’ll have the opportunity to say so in the invite form!

In order to participate in the beta, you must be at least 18 years old and willing to sign our Beta Tester Agreement. A copy of the agreement will be sent along with the beta invite acceptance email. You can apply to the beta by filling out and submitting this form: [url=https://forms.gle/FHd71dMcnn8HjdzT6]https://forms.gle/FHd71dMcnn8HjdzT6[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BHsLyuQ.png[/img]

We have an active official Discord Server that everyone is welcome to join! We’ll be coordinating the beta over Discord as well as sharing development updates and answering questions from the community. You can join the NextGen Pants Discord server here: [url=https://discord.gg/eVVecRg]https://discord.gg/eVVecRg[/url]

Don’t forget, if you haven’t already, you can wishlist Refactor and get notified when it is released. This also helps us out by increasing the visibility of the game before launch, which we deeply appreciate!

Thank you all for being so patient with our little weird game. Your support is always appreciated and let’s make 2020 the year of Refactor!

Sincerely,

The NextGen Pants Team

notes.title: E3 2019 games every game confirmed
notes.content:
They just keep coming don’t they? A lot of games were announced at E3 2019, things that we didn’t know about, as well as stuff that’s previously announced, or expansions to already released games. Now, to the casual outsider, what we’re doing might seem absolutely nuts, but we thought we’d put together an alphabetical list of all the PC games that have been confirmed to appear at this year’s E3 show. With well over a hundred of them now in the books, the next year or so looks packed.

(more…)
